facts.fact: Greg 比平时更暴躁，只顾嘀咕 lord mayor、瘫在椅子里，对 Jessica 带回的农场、教堂、hare 图像与 Round Robin 等消息毫无兴趣。
facts.anchor: Greg was even grumpier than usual, muttering about the lord mayor and slumping in his chair.

facts.fact: Jessica 把修复婚姻押在一顿像样的 Tigglestide 前夜晚餐上，还计划戴上 makeshift ears 扮演 Playboy bunny，喊 Greg 来抓他的 Tigglestide hare。
facts.anchor: Maybe if she could give them a proper Tigglestide Eve, it would fix things.

facts.fact: 梦再次从童年之家的圣像房间开始：圣像之眼在昏暗中发亮，记下每桩过犯并上报 God，Jessica 的父母对祷告一事寸步不让。
facts.anchor: Just like last time, it started in her childhood home, in the room with the icons of the saints on the walls, all their luminous eyes glowing in the gloom.

facts.fact: 梦中她安抚自己已是成年人、身在 Hollyoak House、远离父母，随后在回廊里越绕越深，循着热与光逼近宅子的 heart。
facts.anchor: She was an adult, an adult living her own life on her own terms, and she was here at Hollyoak House, half a world away from her parents and their greedy, grasping fingers.

facts.fact: 宅子心脏处，数十个影子般的人跪拜在一幅几乎填满整个世界的大画前；画像与 foyer 那幅几乎相同，但已异变。
facts.anchor: There were dozens of people here, shadowy forms bowing and scraping upon the floor before a painting on the wall, so huge that it seemed to fill the entire world.

facts.fact: 画像异变：Helena Hollyoak 黑裙敞开、腹部布满 bloody red welts、膝上动物双颊染红，背景暗处还藏着半隐的鬼影生物。
facts.anchor: But now her black dress was open to the navel, exposing her alabaster neck and breasts.

facts.fact: 惊醒时她站在 unlit foyer 的画像前，画像一切如常，grandfather clock 敲了凌晨三点的三响；Sandy 被她说梦话的声音引来撞见。
facts.anchor: Jessica startled awake. She was standing in the unlit foyer, before the portrait of Helena Hollyoak.

facts.fact: 晨起羞耻、自我立志（不再想 Molly）之后，她淋浴时仍忍不住摸侧腹确认：昨晚该有咬痕的地方只剩光滑无痕的皮肤。
facts.anchor: But she still couldn’t help but run her fingers over her flanks as she showered, reassuring herself that where last night were mangled bite marks, today, in the harsh light of morning, there was only smooth and unblemished skin.
